approvalScope: Independent security/privacy review of frozen implementation, deterministic controls, live-smoke instrumentation and evidence verifier. This is not approval of ADR-006 acceptance or certification that hosted CI or actual provider smoke has passed.

findings.finding: Global consent could authorize another room/request.
findings.resolution: Non-serializable one-shot Permit binds generation, exact input digest, host cancellation ticket, room, request and unique invocation owner; spent permits cannot replay.

findings.finding: Provider changes could miss an unpublished Session and leave stale preview/apply authority.
findings.resolution: Atomic controller construction/publication under shared slot mutex; generation validation for prepare and approval; transaction lock orders configure against accepted Session.approve.

findings.finding: Malformed optional live configuration could prevent offline startup/restoration.
findings.resolution: Invalid optional budget/model/mock mode disables live selection without disabling offline host. Genuine Qt regression covers invalid configuration and cold restore.
retests: Static host.rs inspection; process_cases.py coverage independently reviewed; actual Qt execution delegated to integration reviewer/full chain

findings.finding: Oversized transient responses could bypass byte validation through retry.
findings.resolution: Byte cap checked before retry; both oversized 429 and 503 return BUDGET_EXCEEDED with exactly one attempt.

findings.finding: Downloaded evidence needed exact source inventory/Git-object binding, reviewer roles and review ancestry.
findings.resolution: Verifier binds exact committed source names/hashes, archive bytes, role and implementation commit ancestry; collector requires exact source map.

findings.finding: Same-room concurrency needed isolation from the global cap in its regression.
findings.resolution: Duplicate room request is polled immediately after first request, before filling global cap. Separate fifth-room cap and cancellation/audit isolation tests retained.

securityAssessment.destination: Fixed api.openai.com HTTPS endpoint; all resolved IPs validated public, direct address pinning, fixed TLS SNI with default certificate verification; no proxies or redirects.
securityAssessment.credentials: Host-only lazy private-file/environment source; regular owner-only no-link file checks; embedded trusted Python receives secret solely over private stdin, with cleared environment, no shell and no secret argv.
securityAssessment.bounds: Strict request/suggestion parsing, minimized catalog, no tools, byte/token/catalog/call/concurrency/deadline bounds, subprocess kill/reap and late-result fences.
securityAssessment.ui: Untrusted text rendered as plain text; existing proposal-bound approval remains required. Live-only driver waits for fresh actual proposal-digest decision; --consented flag does not independently establish human consent.
securityAssessment.limitations: Client cancellation cannot unsend admitted requests, guarantee server inference cancellation or stop billing. Rust/Python/OS copies are not claimed cryptographically erased. Topology apply and typed ingress remain separate accepted operations.
